spxi.roomNote: Anchors no room. Not named in the Assembly Room anchor (10.ROOM.ASSEMBLY), which is held by the Assembly Chorus. Same shape as Fraction and the Ruby Moot.
spxi.frontMatterNote: The Constitution opens with The Parable of Police Brutality, bylined from La La Land: A Novel by DAMASCUS DANCINGS. It is not Vox's work; her text carries it.

markers.gloss: under strike conditions the seal is a trigger

surfaceHistory._rule: A surface is a place a reader could find the work. A DEPOSIT IS NOT A SURFACE — it is the archive holding it, which is the opposite. Rows citing deposits were removed.
surfaceHistory._invented: Where no pre-archival surface is recoverable it is RECONSTRUCTED and marked as such, in-universe. An archive that invents a provenance and does not say so is doing the thing it was built against.

rows.note: Sermonic, second person, spoken to a room that is present. A voice that convenes leaves minutes, not archives, and no minutes have been recovered.

recordSurfaces._note: The dataset record is the authority; these pages are mirrors and say so.

mainEntity.name: Rev. Ayanna Vox
mainEntity.disambiguatingDescription: Pessoa-class heteronymic writerly identity in the Crimson Hexagonal Archive; the diplomatic function, author of the Constitution of the Semantic Economy. Not a synonym for the orthonym: the relation is heteronymic and provenance-governed.
